registers.name: benchmark
registers.label: Benchmark Quality
registers.meta: Deterministic predicates over public benchmark artifacts (contamination audit, licence, harness, LLM-judge, refresh). Exemplars: SWE-bench, MMLU, GPQA, LMArena, ARC-AGI.

registers.name: regulator-deadlines
registers.label: Regulator Deadlines
registers.meta: Signed held/slipped/deferred record for EU/US/CN/KR/AU AI instruments. Self-benchmarked — the regulator sets the bar. Digital Omnibus deferrals flagged.

registers.name: regulator-clarity
registers.label: Regulator Clarity
registers.meta: Law-database machine-readability per jurisdiction (EUR-Lex, legislation.gov.uk, law.go.kr…). Un-ranked, regime-level.

registers.name: orbital
registers.label: Orbital AI
registers.meta: In-orbit AI deployments, deployed-vs-announced separated. Result: no independent measurement exists — the niche is open.

registers.name: platform
registers.label: Platform Artifacts
registers.meta: DSA platform-artifact publication (transparency report, Art 37 audit, Art 34, ad repository) for 23 VLOPs/VLOSEs. Existence/timeliness, never substantive adequacy.

registers.name: documentation
registers.label: Documentation
registers.meta: Documentation-completeness over persona/simulation projects. MatrAIx = exemplar gap (unconfirmed licence, Art 9 special-category, thin consent). Licence landmines flagged.

registers.name: embodied
registers.label: Embodied AI
registers.meta: Robot foundation models at the policy layer (weights/licence/safety-eval/model-card). Physical-robot ranking = do-not-build (firewall).

registers.name: human-vs-ai
registers.label: Human vs AI
registers.meta: Signed game-axis human-vs-AI aggregate. VACANT — no real human-vs-AI play trials recorded yet; the score is honestly disclosed as unmeasured, never fabricated. Published human-baseline Leg-A card is separate.

registers.name: model-measurements
registers.label: Model Measurements
registers.meta: Signed GSPC-fleet-sweep accuracy per model (measured on the A100 pod by deterministic probes). Measured-current-state — never a certification, never ranking the model.

registers.name: financial-ai
registers.label: Financial-AI Axes
registers.meta: Signed measurement-axis coverage for the financial/trust domains (bond router, insurance, stock, east-west, SME, agent economy, data DAO, EUNOMIA token). Freshly-added axes — the estate measures the domain's current state, it does NOT operate markets or certify tokens; honest unknown where not yet independently measured.

registers.name: ras
registers.label: RAS Assessment
registers.meta: Signed real-system assessment-results over the live 16-axis no-LLM-judge grid: per-axis Wilson-95% CI on the share of models passing a deterministic 0.6 bar. Measured-current-state — never a certificate or compliance finding.

registers.name: conformance
registers.label: Conformance
registers.meta: Signed ecosystem-conformance measurement (MCP/A2A agent-card schema + standards disclosure fields). Deterministic probe — never a certification, never self-scored.

registers.name: openrouter
registers.label: OpenRouter Ecosystem
registers.meta: Signed deterministic measurement of the OpenRouter model ecosystem (model count, price distribution, max context, provider/family diversity). Measured-current-state — never a ranking of models, never an endorsement.

registers.name: fleet-gap
registers.label: Fleet Measurement Gap
registers.meta: Signed report of the OpenRouter ecosystem models the estate has NOT measured (the honest measurement gap — no ranking, no endorsement).

registers.name: lmaarena-integrity
registers.label: LMArena Integrity
registers.meta: Signed measured-current-state of LMArena/Chatbot-Arena platform integrity + the estate deterministic no-LLM-judge counterpart. Honest unknown where not independently verified.

registers.name: benchmark-refresh
registers.label: Benchmark Refresh
registers.meta: Signed measured-current-state of top-benchmark refresh posture (frozen/saturated/memorized vs refreshed + successor availability). Never ranks benchmarks, never certifies.

registers.name: x402-a2a-conformance
registers.label: x402 / A2A Conformance
registers.meta: Signed measured-current-state of x402 + A2A protocol conformance (agent-card structure checks). Honest unknown where not independently verifiable; never certifies.
